parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: CAC method supported; : 0: Continuous CAC, : 1: Continuous with dedicated radio, : 2: Multi-Input Multi-Output (MIMO) dimension reduced, : 3: Time sliced CAC.

parameters.name: NumberOfSeconds
parameters.description: Number of {{units}} required to complete this method of CAC.

object.description: List of Channel Availability Check (CAC) method information for each type of CAC that the radio can perform. Each type is defined by a method and time to complete. For each type, the classes and channels allowed are enumerated.
